capabilities.input_requirements: Validated CSV and an explicit character profile with full speaker coverage.
capabilities.output_behavior: VoiceItems and linked subtitles import in exact text/character order for the two observed packets.
capabilities.limitations: YMM4 may recompute durations; evidence is limited to the observed profiles and packets.
capabilities.failure_modes: Mapping dialog, alias mismatch, default-character collapse, text/order drift.
capabilities.fallback: Fail the import gate and repair the character profile or CSV before visual work.
capabilities.recommended_default_use: Narration baseline and timing anchor.
capabilities.prohibited_overclaim: Does not prove arbitrary CSVs, fixed timing, subtitle typography, images, or rendering.

capabilities.input_requirements: A previously imported project plus append-only diagnostic visual items.
capabilities.output_behavior: The exact nine VoiceItems remain unchanged while fixed Image/Text placeholders are added.
capabilities.limitations: Observed only for one fixed diagnostic project.
capabilities.failure_modes: VoiceItem mutation, scene-span drift, missing item family, private path leakage.
capabilities.fallback: Regenerate from the imported base and compare canonical VoiceItem digests.
capabilities.recommended_default_use: Pattern to preserve narration while adding bounded diagnostic visuals.
capabilities.prohibited_overclaim: The fixed builder is not a variable-scene generic architecture.

capabilities.input_requirements: The exact local project and its original local PNG asset.
capabilities.output_behavior: One project with 9 VoiceItems, 3 ImageItems and 3 independent TextItems opens without error and labels are readable.
capabilities.limitations: No screenshot, render, variable counts, or cross-machine proof.
capabilities.failure_modes: Missing absolute asset path, project parse error, unreadable diagnostic label.
capabilities.fallback: Use the VoiceItem-only project or rebuild absolute asset references on the current machine.
capabilities.recommended_default_use: Evidence anchor for a minimal same-machine diagnostic combination.
capabilities.prohibited_overclaim: Does not prove production composition or generic Image/Text placement.

capabilities.input_requirements: Precomposed local PNG cards and a diagnostic dialogue project.
capabilities.output_behavior: Four external PNG cards were reported visible with dialogue and audio in a diagnostic render observation.
capabilities.limitations: No retained container/decode evidence and card timing regions remained unknown.
capabilities.failure_modes: Card not visible, stale path, density/readability failure, timing overlap.
capabilities.fallback: Use a single scene placeholder or static no-card narration baseline.
capabilities.recommended_default_use: Bounded precomposed card overlay after rights and readability review.
capabilities.prohibited_overclaim: Observed render completion without decode is not C4 or production acceptance.

capabilities.input_requirements: Saved project readback after actual import/open observation.
capabilities.output_behavior: VoiceItem and exact diagnostic scene spans have positive Frame/Length values and stable order.
capabilities.limitations: Arbitrary collision resolution and production pacing are not proven.
capabilities.failure_modes: Overlaps, non-positive length, stale provisional timing, YMM4 duration recomputation.
capabilities.fallback: Anchor visuals to observed VoiceItem intervals and fail on invalid spans.
capabilities.recommended_default_use: Cue-relative timing anchors, never fixed episode constants.
capabilities.prohibited_overclaim: One observed duration is not a reusable production timing contract.

capabilities.input_requirements: Fixed Image/Text layer allocation above imported VoiceItems.
capabilities.output_behavior: The exact placeholder layers open together without an unexpected item-family failure.
capabilities.limitations: No generic allocator or overlap solver exists.
capabilities.failure_modes: Layer collision, hidden item, caption-safe-area overlap.
capabilities.fallback: Use a known sparse layer profile and static readback before observation.
capabilities.recommended_default_use: Sparse known layer roles with explicit readback.
capabilities.prohibited_overclaim: Does not prove arbitrary track layouts or collision-free composition.

capabilities.input_requirements: Known GroupItem template and validated anchor/motion map.
capabilities.output_behavior: Specific GroupItem X/Y/Zoom motion kept body and face synchronized.
capabilities.limitations: Specific template only; arbitrary Image/Text motion is not implied.
capabilities.failure_modes: Anchor jump, wrong facing, body/face separation, excessive travel.
capabilities.fallback: Static GroupItem hold at the last validated anchor.
capabilities.recommended_default_use: Restrained named GroupItem movement only.
capabilities.prohibited_overclaim: Do not generalize to every item family or freeform camera motion.

observed_versions_environments: Named calibration and YMM4 preview observations
capabilities.input_requirements: Known GroupItem template, bounded keyframes and neutral return anchor.
capabilities.output_behavior: Named nod/rotation and bounded Y movement were visible for selected patterns.
capabilities.limitations: Timing, facing and continuity warnings apply; arbitrary tilt/parallax remains unproven.
capabilities.failure_modes: Slow or single-feeling nod, anchor discontinuity, backward-looking travel.
capabilities.fallback: Static expression change or no motion.
capabilities.recommended_default_use: One restrained named emphasis per scene after visual review.
capabilities.prohibited_overclaim: Observed nod does not prove a generic tilt, parallax, or camera system.

capabilities.input_requirements: Fixed system font, size, color, top-left position and short diagnostic label.
capabilities.output_behavior: The three fixed diagnostic labels were reported readable.
capabilities.limitations: Wrapping, arbitrary fonts, long text, subtitle layout and cross-platform metrics remain unproven.
capabilities.failure_modes: Clipping, anchor mismatch, wrapping failure, poor contrast.
capabilities.fallback: Shorten the label or bake reviewed text into a precomposed local image.
capabilities.recommended_default_use: Short bounded labels only, with YMM4 visual review after a material layout change.
capabilities.prohibited_overclaim: Readable fixed labels do not prove a typography engine.

capabilities.input_requirements: Tracked named template, registry entry and all local assets present.
capabilities.output_behavior: Specific named templates can be placed and observed without rebuilding their internal groups.
capabilities.limitations: Only listed templates are proven; generic automated placement remains C2.
capabilities.failure_modes: Missing template, missing asset, anchor mismatch, stale absolute path.
capabilities.fallback: Static pose or omit the template-dependent motion.
capabilities.recommended_default_use: Reuse only explicitly observed named templates.
capabilities.prohibited_overclaim: A template library is not cross-topic production proof.

observed_versions_environments: YMM4 preview observations of tracked local expression assets
capabilities.input_requirements: Known local expression image set and stable body anchor.
capabilities.output_behavior: Expression changes were visible in the bounded probes.
capabilities.limitations: Asset-specific and not a generic facial-animation system.
capabilities.failure_modes: Missing image, path mismatch, mistimed change, semantic mismatch.
capabilities.fallback: Single neutral expression.
capabilities.recommended_default_use: Optional character accent when the tracked asset rights are known.
capabilities.prohibited_overclaim: Does not prove arbitrary face-part or lip-sync animation.

capabilities.input_requirements: Contiguous static scene spans without transition effects.
capabilities.output_behavior: A static hard-cut/continuous baseline opens and remains reviewable.
capabilities.limitations: Does not address pacing quality or transition aesthetics.
capabilities.failure_modes: Abrupt semantic cut or visual discontinuity.
capabilities.fallback: Split the narration or keep one static scene longer.
capabilities.recommended_default_use: Minimum-cost transition baseline.
capabilities.prohibited_overclaim: A working hard cut does not prove edited pacing quality.

capabilities.input_requirements: Effect object copied from a known compatible sample or template.
capabilities.output_behavior: Selected named effects in the calibration set were observable.
capabilities.limitations: Raw effect-name synthesis and community-plugin availability are not generic.
capabilities.failure_modes: Missing plugin, incompatible serialized object, excessive motion.
capabilities.fallback: No effect or static transform using a known route.
capabilities.recommended_default_use: Off by default; use only a named observed preset.
capabilities.prohibited_overclaim: One observed preset does not prove the effect catalog.

capabilities.input_requirements: The exact internal project, fresh operator output and local media-validation tools.
capabilities.output_behavior: One 1920x1080 60fps H.264/AAC MP4 passed ISO-BMFF, ffprobe and full-file decode.
capabilities.limitations: Semantic cue alignment, visual quality, production and rights acceptance remain unknown.
capabilities.failure_modes: Stale output, hash mismatch, JSON masquerading as media, malformed boxes, probe/decode failure, excessive bitrate.
capabilities.fallback: Keep static project evidence and regenerate only under a separately authorized render gate.
capabilities.recommended_default_use: Milestone render verification, not routine H0 conformance.
capabilities.prohibited_overclaim: A decodable file does not prove correct visuals, pacing, editorial quality, or public readiness.

capabilities.input_requirements: A verified source render and proxy-generation tools.
capabilities.output_behavior: One 1280x720 60fps H.264/AAC review proxy passed full decode.
capabilities.limitations: This is media derivative evidence, not YMM4 render semantics.
capabilities.failure_modes: Proxy/source identity drift, decode failure, source overwrite.
capabilities.fallback: Review the immutable original locally if size permits.
capabilities.recommended_default_use: Create only after an authorized verified render needs human review.
capabilities.prohibited_overclaim: Proxy decode does not prove source semantics or editorial acceptance.

capabilities.input_requirements: Existing local image and explicit frame, length, layer and path.
capabilities.output_behavior: An ImageItem object can be deterministically written and parsed.
capabilities.limitations: The generic primitive itself is not observed across arbitrary assets/layouts.
capabilities.failure_modes: Absolute path drift, missing file, invalid item skeleton.
capabilities.fallback: Omit the image or use a verified precomposed same-machine asset.
capabilities.recommended_default_use: Conditional local-image primitive behind a same-machine path check.
capabilities.prohibited_overclaim: C2 object creation is not runtime visibility or portability proof.

capabilities.input_requirements: Short text and explicit fixed style/position fields.
capabilities.output_behavior: An independent TextItem object can be deterministically written and parsed.
capabilities.limitations: Arbitrary wrapping, font, anchor and animation semantics are not proven.
capabilities.failure_modes: Clipping, anchor mismatch, unsupported font, excessive text.
capabilities.fallback: Shorten text or use a reviewed precomposed image.
capabilities.recommended_default_use: Static short-label candidate followed by YMM4 visual review.
capabilities.prohibited_overclaim: C2 TextItem creation is not generic typography support.

capabilities.input_requirements: A topic adapter that writes valid ShapeItem geometry and colors.
capabilities.output_behavior: Topic-specific builders materialize and parse static ShapeItems.
capabilities.limitations: No reusable Python ShapeItem builder exists in the generic patch core.
capabilities.failure_modes: Wrong SizeMode, tiny collapsed geometry, color serialization mismatch.
capabilities.fallback: Use a precomposed local image or a previously validated ShapeItem template.
capabilities.recommended_default_use: Static fixture/probe only until a generic builder is justified and observed.
capabilities.prohibited_overclaim: Multiple one-off scripts do not constitute a generic ShapeItem system.

capabilities.input_requirements: Supported ImageItem or GroupItem plus coherent keyframe structure.
capabilities.output_behavior: Transform routes can be segmented and serialized deterministically.
capabilities.limitations: Only specific GroupItem routes have C3 evidence.
capabilities.failure_modes: Route point mismatch, discontinuity, wrong anchor, unsupported target item.
capabilities.fallback: Use static defaults or a named observed GroupItem template.
capabilities.recommended_default_use: Off by default outside observed named templates.
capabilities.prohibited_overclaim: Serialized transform fields do not prove visible motion.

capabilities.input_requirements: Known target item and bounded scale/zoom route.
capabilities.output_behavior: Zoom values and keyframes can be written and read back.
capabilities.limitations: Visual crop, anchor behavior and acceptable zoom amount need YMM4 observation.
capabilities.failure_modes: Cropping, unreadable text, anchor drift, route discontinuity.
capabilities.fallback: Keep zoom at 100 and use a static cut.
capabilities.recommended_default_use: Static default; probe one bounded zoom before runtime adoption.
capabilities.prohibited_overclaim: Static keyframes are not a proven loupe or camera zoom.

capabilities.input_requirements: Supported item and explicit opacity values.
capabilities.output_behavior: Opacity values can be serialized and clipped to a segment.
capabilities.limitations: Animated opacity and layered visual result are unobserved generically.
capabilities.failure_modes: Invisible item, blend ambiguity, discontinuity.
capabilities.fallback: Use opacity 100 with a hard cut.
capabilities.recommended_default_use: Avoid non-default opacity until a bounded probe observes it.
capabilities.prohibited_overclaim: A value in JSON does not prove a reveal/dim animation.

capabilities.input_requirements: Resolved local asset and scene timing spans.
capabilities.output_behavior: Layer-0 background ImageItems can be replaced per span.
capabilities.limitations: Generic YMM4 open/render evidence is absent.
capabilities.failure_modes: Missing path, gap between spans, incorrect layer, visual mismatch.
capabilities.fallback: Use one static known background for the full project.
capabilities.recommended_default_use: Static same-machine background after a path and rights check.
capabilities.prohibited_overclaim: Headless replacement is not runtime visibility proof.

capabilities.input_requirements: Layer-0 image, supported motion label and coherent keyframes.
capabilities.output_behavior: Pan/zoom/Ken-Burns-like keyframes can be materialized.
capabilities.limitations: The integrated-scene observation does not isolate background motion behavior.
capabilities.failure_modes: Edge exposure, crop, sickness, anchor drift, no visible motion.
capabilities.fallback: Static background hold.
capabilities.recommended_default_use: Not in the minimum stack; probe only if a real scene needs it.
capabilities.prohibited_overclaim: Keyframes alone do not prove background animation.

capabilities.input_requirements: Registry-resolved local image, anchor utterance and layer.
capabilities.output_behavior: Overlay ImageItems can be inserted at utterance-relative spans.
capabilities.limitations: Only the separate card path has C3 visibility evidence.
capabilities.failure_modes: Missing registry label, path failure, overlap, unreadable density.
capabilities.fallback: No overlay or one full-scene placeholder image.
capabilities.recommended_default_use: Conditional precomposed overlay after rights and density review.
capabilities.prohibited_overclaim: Insertion tests do not prove layout quality or runtime visibility.

capabilities.input_requirements: Supported none/fade transition request on a valid VoiceItem span.
capabilities.output_behavior: Fade fields can be written to Voice/Jimaku structures.
capabilities.limitations: Runtime visual/audio fade behavior is not generically observed.
capabilities.failure_modes: No visible fade, excessive fade, audio/subtitle mismatch.
capabilities.fallback: Use the proven no-transition baseline.
capabilities.recommended_default_use: Optional after one bounded YMM4 probe.
capabilities.prohibited_overclaim: Static fade fields are not runtime-proven transitions.

capabilities.input_requirements: Validated brief, known templates/assets and compatible effect objects.
capabilities.output_behavior: Named Group/Image recipes with transform routes can be materialized and parsed.
capabilities.limitations: Only separately observed presets may be considered C3.
capabilities.failure_modes: Missing fields, keyframe-count mismatch, effect/plugin incompatibility.
capabilities.fallback: Static pose or one named observed template.
capabilities.recommended_default_use: Outside the minimum stack; use only after the scene benefit exceeds probe cost.
capabilities.prohibited_overclaim: A recipe builder is not a runtime motion system.

observed_versions_environments: Headless geometry/readback after one targeted label repair
capabilities.input_requirements: Domain adapter, fixed Shape/Text geometry and bounded short labels.
capabilities.output_behavior: Three callout slots and labels can be statically materialized in one diagnostic carrier.
capabilities.limitations: The repair is high-cost one-off evidence and final YMM4 visual recheck remained human-owned.
capabilities.failure_modes: Label overflow, anchor mismatch, excessive item count, domain-specific geometry.
capabilities.fallback: Single short TextItem or a precomposed reviewed callout image.
capabilities.recommended_default_use: Do not make this a default until a generic observed callout probe exists.
capabilities.prohibited_overclaim: One repaired carrier does not generalize callouts.

capabilities.input_requirements: Resolved local audio path and timing/layer fields.
capabilities.output_behavior: An AudioItem can be inserted and parsed structurally.
capabilities.limitations: Playback, volume, rights and mix are not observed generically.
capabilities.failure_modes: Missing media, wrong track, silent output, rights failure.
capabilities.fallback: No sound effect; narration-only baseline.
capabilities.recommended_default_use: Excluded from the minimum visual stack.
capabilities.prohibited_overclaim: Static AudioItem presence does not prove playback or mix quality.

capabilities.input_requirements: A fixture, composition grammar, primitive catalog and capability matrix.
capabilities.output_behavior: Inspection, process and comparison fixtures pass the same validator with different scene/cue counts.
capabilities.limitations: Static fixture variance is not real-topic reuse or YMM4 behavior.
capabilities.failure_modes: Unknown reference, orphan cue, duplicate ID, evidence gap without fallback.
capabilities.fallback: Use the narration baseline or reject the fixture before project generation.
capabilities.recommended_default_use: Preflight visual recipes before any project generation.
capabilities.prohibited_overclaim: Three static fixtures do not establish C5 or production readiness.

capabilities.input_requirements: A separately authorized generic capability probe.
capabilities.output_behavior: Proposed reveal, sweep, tilt, pulse, zoom and sequence intents have no runtime output yet.
capabilities.limitations: Not implemented and not authorized.
capabilities.failure_modes: Unsupported effect, misleading motion, excessive cost, rights or geometry mismatch.
capabilities.fallback: Static Image/Text/Shape placeholder using only capabilities already evidenced.
capabilities.recommended_default_use: Do not use in H0; nominate only the smallest primitive for H1.
capabilities.prohibited_overclaim: Route selection does not turn proposed motion into capability.

observed_versions_environments: Only same-machine absolute ImageItem references observed
capabilities.input_requirements: A second machine or a proven relative/rebinding path strategy.
capabilities.output_behavior: No cross-machine success is established.
capabilities.limitations: Current local project references are machine-specific.
capabilities.failure_modes: Missing assets, different root, version/plugin/profile drift.
capabilities.fallback: Regenerate or rebind absolute local paths on the target machine.
capabilities.recommended_default_use: Treat every project as same-machine until a dedicated probe passes.
capabilities.prohibited_overclaim: Warning-only version tolerance is not portability proof.

capabilities.input_requirements: At least two heterogeneous real-topic workflows using the same generic core without core-code change.
capabilities.output_behavior: No qualifying C5 output exists.
capabilities.limitations: Existing real packets use separate topic-specific builders/contracts.
capabilities.failure_modes: Hidden topic branch, core edit for second episode, changed evidence/cost assumptions.
capabilities.fallback: Keep claims at supported archetype and static-conformance level.
capabilities.recommended_default_use: Use only as an H2 evidence gate, never as a current claim.
capabilities.prohibited_overclaim: Two packets or three synthetic fixtures are not C5.

observed_versions_environments: Import structure observed; visual subtitle review absent
capabilities.input_requirements: Actual YMM4 visual observation at the intended frame/layout and font settings.
capabilities.output_behavior: No generic readability or safe-area result is established.
capabilities.limitations: Linked subtitle existence is not typography/layout evidence.
capabilities.failure_modes: Clipping, overlap, poor contrast, unsafe line breaks, anchor mismatch.
capabilities.fallback: Use default linked subtitles and reserve the bottom safe area until reviewed.
capabilities.recommended_default_use: Human/YMM4 gate before visual acceptance.
capabilities.prohibited_overclaim: Imported subtitles are not visually accepted subtitles.

observed_versions_environments: Repository policy and current H0 network boundary
capabilities.input_requirements: A future separately authorized rights-aware acquisition lane.
capabilities.output_behavior: The current visual core does not fetch or clear external assets.
capabilities.limitations: No rights automation or network-backed asset registry.
capabilities.failure_modes: Rights violation, unstable URL, privacy leak, non-reproducible asset.
capabilities.fallback: Original abstract geometry or a user-provided cleared local asset.
capabilities.recommended_default_use: Do not build inside the generic visual core.
capabilities.prohibited_overclaim: A local path field is not asset acquisition or rights clearance.

capabilities.input_requirements: New implementation and a bounded YMM4 observation.
capabilities.output_behavior: No wipe, slide, dissolve family beyond the current fade contract is available.
capabilities.limitations: Intentionally outside the current patch contract.
capabilities.failure_modes: Validation rejection or silent unsupported effect behavior.
capabilities.fallback: Use the proven no-transition baseline or conditional fade.
capabilities.recommended_default_use: Do not build unless a real episode demonstrates recurring value.
capabilities.prohibited_overclaim: An unrecognized label is not a supported transition.

observed_versions_environments: Generic patch core inspected; only topic-specific shape builders found
capabilities.input_requirements: A reusable schema/builder plus static and YMM4 observation evidence.
capabilities.output_behavior: No generic core method creates arbitrary ShapeItems today.
capabilities.limitations: Topic scripts duplicate geometry and cannot be imported as generic architecture.
capabilities.failure_modes: Topic branch explosion, malformed geometry, repeated one-off repair.
capabilities.fallback: Precomposed local image or a previously validated static template.
capabilities.recommended_default_use: Do not add until H1 proves a small reusable primitive set is worth it.
capabilities.prohibited_overclaim: Topic builders do not equal a generic ShapeItem core.

observed_versions_environments: Inventory found no dedicated template or visual pass
capabilities.input_requirements: A reusable Shape/Text or precomposed balloon route and YMM4 visual observation.
capabilities.output_behavior: No generic balloon template exists in the current core.
capabilities.limitations: Callout-like topic probes do not establish speech-balloon semantics.
capabilities.failure_modes: Text overflow, wrong speaker association, overlap, density increase.
capabilities.fallback: Short independent TextItem or narration-only cue.
capabilities.recommended_default_use: Exclude from the minimum stack.
capabilities.prohibited_overclaim: A proposed Shape/Text route is not a supported balloon.

observed_versions_environments: Human internal review of the older diagnostic card surface
capabilities.input_requirements: A redesigned and re-reviewed surface would be required.
capabilities.output_behavior: The observed older card composition failed production-quality review.
capabilities.limitations: Negative evidence applies to that surface, not every future card design.
capabilities.failure_modes: Clipping, missing wrapping, unbalanced type scale, poor readability and insufficient variation.
capabilities.fallback: Use a sparse single-focus static scene or narration baseline.
capabilities.recommended_default_use: Do not reuse the failed surface as a generic design system.
capabilities.prohibited_overclaim: Mechanical rendering does not imply production visual quality.
